Name: Alternate Portraits for Boarding House Gregory and Sheila
Author: AirynS
Description:
Alternate portraits for the NPCs Gregory & Sheila from the mod [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4120]Boarding House & Bus Stop Extension[/url]﻿ by TrentXV & Eros, including seasonal outfits. This mod will not work without Boarding House because it’s a portrait replacer, so please download & endorse Trent’s work! There are two sections - one is a CP mod to replace the regular portraits and one is a replacer for Gregory and Sheila’s shop portraits, as these portraits can’t be targeted by CP and must be manually replaced.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]:
[list=1]
[*]Unzip the folder to extract the “[BH] Boarding House” and “[CP] Alternate Portraits for Boarding House Gregory & Sheila” folders.
[*]Drop the “[CP] Alternate Portraits for Boarding House Gregory & Sheila” folder into your Mods folder.
[*]Drop the “[BH] Boarding House” folder into your Mods folder or the subfolder where Boarding House is located and allow it to overwrite.
[*]If this doesn’t work for some reason, take the png files from the [STF] Buffalo’s Ranch/assets folder, drop them in the equivalent folder in Boarding House, and allow them to overwrite.
[/list]

If you like my work, you can buy me a coffee [url=https://ko-fi.com/airyn]here![/url]
